EnhancedFileSave.description: Save VIDEO / STRING / IMAGE / AUDIO from one input, with exact filenames, %date% timestamps and optional sequence numbers.

filename_template.name: Filename
filename_template.tooltip: May include subfolders such as project/shot_%date%. %date% is replaced using the timestamp options below.

append_sequence.name: Append sequence number
append_sequence.tooltip: When disabled, no automatic ComfyUI counter is appended. Existing targets are overwritten.

video_format.name: Video container
video_format.tooltip: Uses the current ComfyUI native SaveVideo container options.

video_codec.name: Video codec
video_codec.tooltip: Uses the current ComfyUI native SaveVideo codec options.

TerryVideoCompare.description: A/B synchronized video comparison preview. Drag the center divider to inspect differences; the bottom timeline controls both videos together.

TerryH3PromptEditor.description: Visual MiniMax H3 prompt editor with dynamic image, video and audio references. Use @ for media and / for H3 syntax commands; output is always standard H3 STRING text.

visual_preview.name: Visual Preview
visual_preview.tooltip: On: visualize tags. Off: show raw H3 text.

TerryH3ShotTimeline.description: Timeline mode of Terry H3 Prompt Editor with multi-reference assets, tagged shot descriptions, shot ordering and duration editing, plus optional soundscape/music fields.

TerryWireBusPack.description: Bundle any number of connections into one virtual bus. Supports KJNodes Get/Set.

TerryWireBusUnpack.description: Restore the original connection count, types and order from a virtual bus. Supports KJNodes Get/Set.
